W_vault_adapter_keeps_its_own_lf_only_re._note:
#4461 WIRING: the READ path stops asking core and asks its own pre-#4441 LF-only regex again — the exact shape this migration removed. Type-preserving (same object shape), so a BROKEN verdict cannot be confused with redness (§A36/§A97).
⛤ B3/B4/B5 were in the FIRST prediction and did NOT redden — recorded, not smoothed (integration-test-revert-verify §A44). The prediction was the union of the old in-class M1+M2 expectations, i.e. derived from the mutant's THEME («both tolerances gone»); what actually executes is narrower. B3/B4/B5 assert that a MALFORMED CRLF/BOM asset is NAMED IN THE SKIP LIST, and that verdict comes from the DIAGNOSTIC path (`getFrontmatterParseFailure`), which this mutant leaves on core. So the file still gets named; only its triples vanish. That asymmetry is exactly what M3 of `issue-4441-crlf-bom.adapter.spec.json` owns (it reddens B3/B4/B5/B9 by giving the diagnostic path its OWN regex), and the two mutants together cover both halves of req c05a3565's «read and diagnostic agree by construction» clause — neither alone does.
⛤ B6/B8/B15/B16 assert the ABSENCE of a side effect and are legitimately green in both directions (§ось на ОТСУТСТВИЕ побочного эффекта); B7/B12 do not reach the widened shapes.
